title: 논문 근거로 질문 답하기
description: Kadera(카더라 말고) answers Korean health, medicine, drug, food, nutrition, supplement, exercise, sleep, parenting, child-development, psychology, education, and study questions using current scholarly evidence rather than general model knowledge. Use it for effects, benefits, risks, side effects, safety, comparisons, and everyday claims. It returns a concise Korean conclusion, paper citations and links, plus reusable paper IDs; preserve those IDs and links in the answer so the user can request a paper detail.
